wheel.lug_torque: 96 lb-ft (130 N·m) per wheel-data listings; confirm in your handbook

max_tire.note: Discoweb owners recommend 245s for a stock truck. 265/75R16 fits at stock height but rubs the plastic behind the fog lamps at full lock or needs the front bumper trimmed.
The common choice with a mild OME-type lift; one owner with a 2-inch lift reports no rubbing.
Needs a little more than the standard OME lift (owners use OME 751 springs and reset the SLS height to get nearly 3 inches); expect gearing and halfshaft-strength concerns.

items.title: ACE high-pressure pipe can fracture at the pump
items.summary: The high-pressure pipe from the ACE pump to the valve block could fracture at its union with the pump; dealers fitted new tubing.

items.title: Left-side engine idler pulley can fracture
items.summary: Belt loads could exceed the pulley's design limit, so it could break and throw the serpentine belt; dealers fitted an improved pulley.

items.title: Water in automatic transmission fluid; park lock
items.summary: Water contamination of the ATF could stop the park lock working; dealers repositioned the breather and tested or flushed the fluid.

items.title: ABS sensor contamination causes unwanted ABS activation
items.summary: Contamination of an ABS sensor could be misread by the ABS ECU; dealers installed a new ECU.

items.title: Accelerator cable kinked at assembly
items.summary: A kinked cable could chafe and break its inner strands; dealers inspected and replaced cables.

items.title: Throttle can stick intermittently
items.summary: Intermittent throttle sticking could raise engine speed; dealers replaced the throttle body.

items.title: ABS modulator valve-cover bolts can crack
items.summary: Flexing valve covers could crack their retaining bolts; dealers strengthened the covers and replaced the bolts.

items.title: ACE pump banjo bolt loses torque
items.summary: The ACE pump banjo bolt could loosen and leak; dealers re-torqued it or replaced the bolt and Dowty washers.

items.title: Replacement rear driveshaft coupling (service part)
items.summary: TVF100010 rear couplings made April–November 2011 could start to separate; check any coupler replaced around then.

tsbs.title: Td5 oil-pump sprocket bolt
tsbs.summary: Early bolts were fitted without thread lock and can fall out, wrecking the engine; the superseded bolt comes pre-thread-locked (25 Nm). Owners have found loose bolts on 2003–04 trucks too.

tsbs.title: Td5 injector harness (later modified part)
tsbs.summary: Failed O-rings at the head connector let oil wick down the loom into the ECU; fit the later modified harness.

tsbs.title: Td5 fuel pressure regulator revisions
tsbs.summary: The regulator was modified during production and again from 2003 with an extra return pipe for 15P engines; order by chassis number.

identify.intro: A Disco 2 is easy to tell from a Disco 1, but which options it left the factory with (SLS, ACE, CDL lever, engine version) decides what you're buying.

items.head: Series I or Series II?
items.body: The Series II's rear stop lights sit above the window line (the Series I's are below), the paddle door handles are gone, the tail is longer, and the wheels are 5x120 instead of the Series I's 5x6.5 in.

items.head: Pre-facelift or facelift (D2a)?
items.body: Facelift trucks (2003 model year on) have 'pocketed' headlamps like the L322 Range Rover and revised rear lamps with the indicators moved up out of the bumper.

items.head: Td5 10P or 15P
items.body: Later Euro 3 Td5s (15P) have EGR and a fuel pressure regulator with an extra return pipe. Order Td5 parts by chassis number because many changed mid-run.

items.head: SLS and ACE
items.body: SLS trucks have rear air springs instead of coils and a compressor in a plastic box on the left-hand chassis rail, level with the front seats. ACE trucks have a valve block on the right-hand chassis rail with steel lines running to the anti-roll bars.

items.head: Centre diff lock
items.body: Look for a diff-lock position on the transfer lever. Early trucks have the lock in the LT230 but no linkage unless one has been fitted from a Discovery 1 (matching manual or auto) or a kit.

items.head: US truck or import
items.body: US-market Series IIs were all V8 automatics (4.0 for 1999–2002, 4.6 for 2003–04). A Td5 or manual in the US is a private import, so check the VIN, build date and paperwork.

paragraphs: Land Rover only sold V8 automatics in the US, so a Td5 or a manual Discovery 2 there is a gray-market import. NHTSA lets a vehicle at least 25 years old, counted from its date of manufacture, be imported without meeting FMVSS. Series IIs were built from autumn 1998 to May 2004, so as of October 2026 trucks built before October 2001 qualify and later ones follow month by month. EPA Form 3520-1 code E covers vehicles at least 21 years old in original configuration.

Make sure the VIN, chassis number and build date on the plate agree, because the 25 years run from the build date, not the registration date. Check your state's titling and emissions rules before you buy, especially for a diesel in California.
